meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: Claude 会读取 lark-shared 的认证配置，以 user 身份获取指定日期的日程列表和未完成待办，然后整理成摘要：日程按时间排序、检测冲突，待办按截止时间排序，最后输出日程表、待办列表和小结（含空闲时段）。
howto.when: 当你说“今天有哪些安排”“明天有什么会”“这周还有哪些待办”这类话，或要求生成 standup/早报摘要时触发。

say.text: 今天有什么日程和未完成任务？
say.note: 会生成今天的日程表与待办摘要。

say.text: 帮我出明天上午的 standup 摘要
say.note: 只取明天相关日程与未完成待办。

say.text: 汇总一下本周剩余的安排和待办
say.note: 按本周日期范围获取并汇总。

howto.what_en: After being invoked, Claude reads lark-shared for auth, fetches the specified date's calendar events and incomplete tasks, converts timestamps to local time, sorts events by start time, detects time conflicts, and outputs a summary with a schedule table, todo list, and a note including free slots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about today's/tomorrow's/this week's schedule or pending tasks, or request a standup/morning briefing summary.

say_en.text: What's on my schedule and to-dos today?
say_en.note: Generates today's schedule and todo summary.

say_en.text: Give me a standup summary for tomorrow morning.
say_en.note: Fetches tomorrow's agenda and pending tasks.

say_en.text: Summarize the rest of this week's plans and to-dos.
say_en.note: Uses the week's date range and summarizes.
